title: FIFTH LEVEL SPELLS - the 12 fifth level shukenja spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and sohei codes
audit_label: R663 OA fifth level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round fifty (capture pp. 140-143): the fifth level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and sohei-usable markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: FIFTH LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 140-143 - the OA fifth level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read - the 12 fifth level spell stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes (print pp. 140-143; compressed pp. 68-70); all 12 schools, component sets, casting times and saving throws agree, zero contested stat reads. The level lists twelve spells (the R658 T62 grid settled the size); advice takes the verbal component only; air walk casts in a single segment; three spells take the eight-segment cast (cure critical wounds, dispel evil, true seeing); raise dead and remember carry the special saves. Alteration and divination tie as the most common school at three spells each, with no evocation or conjuration spell this level. The reversible flags agree between the passes; the sohei-usable marks ride the R658 T62 grid, settled five rounds before. The stat grid pins as a table: 12 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special, 3 half), reversible and sohei markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag L5Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
